scope: Completed resumed UI-only, worker-only and audio-only continuation orchestration and saved CPU audits only. No host commands, GPU, build/test workload or new measurement ran while packaging.
baseline_preservation: Prior committed observed-both-hour and original pause archives were not changed. Prior pause copies are named prior-pause-request.json and prior-pause-completed.json in this separate continuation directory.
suite_state_note: final-suite-state.json snapshots completed measurement/cleanup before report generation; older historical fields are preserved as recorded.
negative_preflight_note: resume-preflight-battery.json recorded AC offline before the user connected power; resume-preflight-ac.json is the later AC-online snapshot.
source_note: Seven orchestration helpers were checked against the recorded resume-request helper pins. Other source copies are exact current-byte snapshots with SHA256 in manifest; they do not independently prove historical execution byte identity unless separately pinned in run launch/result metadata. Relative source paths are unchanged, requiring original workspace layout for orchestration replay.
selected_monitor: Only resume-monitor.jsonl was copied, deterministic gzip with exact raw hash/size verification; combined old monitor and full-local kernel journals excluded.
user_thermal_guidance: Brief hot spikes are acceptable; no new sustained-duration threshold was invented. Existing host policy/thermal guard/readiness remained unchanged.
excluded: No binaries, model, WAV/F32 audio, media, private full journals or unrelated repository files.
